_instructions: Spec template for `kappmaker generate-feature-image --spec <file>`. Fill every empty field; keys starting with `_` are stripped before the spec is sent to the image model.
The output is the Google Play feature graphic: ONE wide 1024×500 banner (center-cover cropped), not a phone screenshot.
Text on the banner must be ONLY the real app name (and optionally the real subtitle) — never invented marketing copy or lorem text. Repeat them verbatim in constraints.
Still pass --logo / --reference on the command line — those control which images are uploaded; this spec describes how they are used (left_panel app_icon, right_panel screen_content).
Run `kappmaker generate-feature-image --print-prompt --prompt ... --app-name ... --primary-color ...` to see the full authoring guidance with your reference-image setup baked in.
constraints: 16:9 wide banner, no empty corners or dead space, crisp legible text, no logo distortion, no fake UI text — only the app name and subtitle given above
